parameters.name: objectDesignator

Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Name of operator.A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2) , Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Name of the object owner.A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2) , Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: maxCreationDate
parameters.description: Retrieve only the latest OCM per object designator.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of results to return.  Default of 0 means return all possible results.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for the queried OCM(s), indexed by 0 (first page). Default is 0

parameters.name: headersOnly
parameters.description: Return a reduced object. works with filters messageId, creationDate, objectDesignator, operator
